title: A second DNA binding site on RFC facilitates clamp loading at gapped or nicked DNA
authors: Xingchen Liu; Christl Gaubitz; Joshua Pajak; Brian A Kelch
one_liner_zh: 该文通过结构生物学和生化实验发现RFC钳载器上的第二DNA结合位点，研究其与缺口/缺口DNA的互作机制，虽非TF-DNA体系，但属于蛋白质-DNA互作且机制建模可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Clamp loaders place circular sliding clamp proteins onto DNA so that clamp-binding partner proteins can synthesize, scan, and repair the genome. DNA with nicks or small single-stranded gaps are common clamp-loading targets in DNA repair, yet these substrates would be sterically blocked given the known mechanism for binding of primer-template DNA. Here, we report the discovery of a second DNA binding site in the yeast clamp loader Replication Factor C (RFC) that aids in binding to nicked or gapped DNA. This DNA binding site is on the external surface and is only accessible in the open conformation of RFC. Initial DNA binding at this site thus provides access to the primary DNA binding site in the central chamber. Furthermore, we identify that this site can partially unwind DNA to create an extended single-stranded gap for DNA binding in RFC’s central chamber and subsequent ATPase activation. Finally, we show that deletion of the BRCT domain, a major component of the external DNA binding site, results in defective yeast growth in the presence of DNA damage where nicked or gapped DNA intermediates occur. We propose that RFC’s external DNA binding site acts to enhance DNA binding and clamp loading, particularly at DNA architectures typically found in DNA repair.
abstract_zh: 夹子装载器将环状滑动夹蛋白放置到DNA上，以便夹子结合伴侣蛋白能够合成、扫描和修复基因组。带有切口或小单链间隙的DNA是DNA修复中常见的夹子装载靶标，然而，根据已知的引物-模板DNA结合机制，这些底物会受到空间位阻。在此，我们报告了在酵母夹子装载器复制因子C（RFC）中发现第二个DNA结合位点，该位点有助于结合带切口或间隙的DNA。此DNA结合位点位于外表面，仅在RFC的开放构象中可及。因此，该位点的初始DNA结合为中央腔室中的主要DNA结合位点提供了通路。此外，我们确定该位点能部分解旋DNA，以在RFC的中央腔室中形成延伸的单链间隙，用于DNA结合及随后的ATP酶激活。最后，我们表明删除BRCT结构域（外部DNA结合位点的主要组成部分）在存在DNA损伤（产生带切口或间隙的DNA中间体）时会导致酵母生长缺陷。我们提出RFC的外部DNA结合位点用于增强DNA结合和夹子装载，特别是在DNA修复中常见的DNA结构上。
